versions.name: Emergency Preparedness
versions.description: Work out how to prevent, survive, and recover from disasters from kitchen fires to hurricanes, build a family escape plan and a disaster kit, signal rescuers, and mobilize your troop to help.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
